kind: deterministic regeneration of two already-sealed initial states plus a read-only typed decomposition of their difference. No new parameter, tonic, topology, kernel or gate

frozen.build_path: tests/test_v21_pv_predecessor.py _Sim.fresh_state and _Sim.lambda1_end_state, loaded by path so the build cannot drift from the sealed runs
frozen.model: V2.1 static column, kernel baseline, HDP detached, native noise, jaxfne 0.4.24, dt 0.1 ms

decomposition.unit: typed state block, never an individual floating-point coordinate
decomposition.blocks: every field of DynamicState (v, u, prev_spikes, syn_state, H, w, theta_S, aux, b), flattened through its own structure so a nested field is reported by leaf path
decomposition.per_block: presence in each state, shape, dtype, whether the two states are bitwise identical, max and mean absolute difference, fraction of entries differing, and the same statistics split by cell class where the leading axis is the neuron axis
decomposition.excluded: prng_key and step_index are excluded from the causal candidate set on the P1 result, and are reported only as context
decomposition.purpose: identify the smallest state block that differs between A and B, and therefore which transplant arms are scientifically justified

search_order_for_a_later_lineage: PV incoming synaptic and history state
other-class dynamic state, only if required
broader blocks, only after narrower blocks fail

classification.STATE_DECOMPOSITION_PASS: both states regenerate with the sealed v-hash, the trajectory match holds, and the typed decomposition is complete
classification.STATE_REGENERATION_FAIL: a regenerated state fails its v-hash or the trajectory match; no decomposition is reported

artifacts.not_committed: the two regenerated states written to the session scratch directory as npz and pinned there by sha256

forbidden: any transplant, intervention, clamp or perturbation: M1 is not authorized by this spec
any lambda, tonic, parameter, topology or kernel change
treating a difference in prng_key or step_index as a causal candidate
comparing individual coordinates instead of typed blocks
concluding which block causes the fate: M0 can only say which blocks differ
stop: write results/v21_pv_m0_r2.json with the typed decomposition and the justified transplant arms, then STOP for review
